card.name: Spots right before a negative contraction
card.fires_on: A noun or punctuation mark that is about to be followed by a negated auxiliary such as didn't, doesn't or isn't. It also fires on section-number digits inside bracketed cross-references.

modes.label: Subject before n't
modes.description: A subject noun or phrase where the next word is likely a contraction like doesn't or didn't.
modes.example: Consider what it means to say "your<< vote>> doesn't matter."

modes.label: Clause end before negation
modes.description: A comma or linking word at a clause break where a negative statement follows.

card.plain: It fires on words just before a negative like "doesn't" or "didn't", and on section numbers in label cross-references.
